scope: Visual inspection of all 17 supplied-original MJ atlas pages, 491 frame slots. Diagnostic colors are geometry aids; no character class is inferred solely from resource names or script actions. Uncertain small details remain review candidates.

overrides.note: Bather with visible washing item, held clothes, or bird/branch action in the same drawing.
Complete dressed Johnny poses.
8x1 marker-sized frame.
Ripples, branch, and bird/clothing detail without Johnny.
Tiny striped rectangular detail; no defensible face or limb identification at atlas scale.

resources.notes: Hatless bathing upper-body drawings remain character work. Frames000-003,006-007,035-036 show only upper body; classify as partial even with water marks. Pure water/branch/bird pieces are retained as dependencies.

overrides.note: Whole-body reaching, standing or slumped Johnny.
Johnny or his upper body holding the bottle/message.
Detached arm/hand, lower body, or incomplete body layer; includes arm-less full-height body036.
One-/two-row marker frames.

resources.notes: Bottle, cork, paper-like and fragment drawings are not Johnny. Several action frames deliberately split limbs and body across slots; retain assembly dependencies. Small handheld detail around hands029-032 is not separately identified.

Whole-body throwing or standing poses.

resources.notes: Numerous single-row placeholder slots. The thought vignette remains character art despite its small figures and enclosing bubble.

resources.notes: Many heads, headless bodies and arms are separate layers:016-017,020,023-028,031,033-035,044-046. These must stay in the character inventory. Small handheld coconut sections are marked composite even when only an arm is drawn.

Tiny skin-colored detail tiles000/019/020 and possible fingertips above coconut/leaf025 need enlarged native-pixel identification.

resources.notes: Palm trunk/leaves/coconuts, splash-only frames016-018 and arcs027-029 are separate non-character dependencies. Do not exclude tree-associated frames009-011, which visibly contain Johnny.

overrides.note: Lower-body layers and tiny facial/eye details.

Tiny red/black fragments do not resolve defensibly into body part versus fishing-prop detail on this sheet.

resources.notes: Most seated poses visibly hold a book, including hat-off variants. Frame025 is not just a cap: the attached forearm makes it character work.

resources.notes: Telescope handling poses include upper-body-only composites. Eye/lid views011-012 and017 appear inside the telescope rim and remain character composites, not generic lens props. Tiny eye identity is inferred visually from the neighboring open/closed-eye views.
All4 complete Johnny poses hold a telescope, viewed from different directions.

resources.notes: Every remaining frame is visibly a Johnny head, head/arm assembly, headless body or torso/arm layer. The cap-playing close-ups are character work; this resource is not a complete one-drawing-per-pose cycle.
